## Verdict
REVISE — the design is viable, but section exclusivity and overview lifecycle integration are not sufficiently specified to prevent incorrect navigation and stale rendering.

## Critical gaps
- “Documenting/validating” mutual exclusivity is insufficient: validation currently only warns, while parsing, the section editor, and look import would still permit duplicate session/window/agent rows and ambiguous section ownership. Define centralized normalization or rejection; preferably make `overview` deterministically replace `sessions`, `terminals`, and `agents`.
- The new scroll offset must be integrated beyond state swapping: `sidebarScrollOffsets`, `sidebarSignature`, reveal state/focus handling, cursor indexing, section stepping/cycling, and secondary-rail swapping. Omitting the cache signature causes wheel or cursor scrolling to reuse stale frames.

## Important improvements
- Specify folding semantics. `sidebarSessionRows` removes sessions under folded repository/host groups; with overview exclusive, this also hides their pane rows. Decide whether that is intended and ensure collapsed parents retain sufficient urgency/count information.
- Replace “where feasible” with deterministic row priorities at narrow widths: required connector, state/focus/severity marks, and the order in which queue/subagent figures are dropped.
- Define collapsed-strip acceptance precisely: whether “current session” means one session or the existing full session list, and whether “urgent” includes working/unread-done panes or only attention states.
- Build overview agents through `agentEntries` or equivalent rather than `sidebarAgents`, which is gated on the normal agents section.
- Specify installer atomicity and idempotence: exact-base check, clean patch application, immutable preimage backup, postimage checksum/version verification, rollback on failure, and no daemon signal/restart.
